question: Does a real Ender-3 V3 KE on stock firmware accept the upload address (POST /upload/<name>), the opGcodeFile start command, the pause/stop messages and the camera stream on port 8080 exactly as implemented?
probes: Connect the app to the person's real printer and send a small test print
Check whether the printer's firmware version needs a login or token
resolution: Confirmed by the person's own message (no tool evidence record): on their real Ender-3 V3 KE, upload via POST works, the camera stream works, and the job can be watched while printing. Pause/stop on the real printer were not separately reported.
